description: The Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics publishes the results of Taiwan's 2020 Population and Housing Census as 97 report tables, each as XLSX and ODS with Chinese and English headings, plus a separate set of county and city report tables. The housing tables count housing units by use, completion year (bands from before 1980 to 2016-2020), floor area and building type, vacant housing by age and area, and occupied units by residents, area per person and rooms. Table 88 gives 8,993,149 housing units in all, broken down for each region and the 22 counties and cities. Household tables cover tenure, ownership and internet access at home, and tables 16 to 25 describe where people work compared with where they live and the commuters who cross township or county lines. Results of the 1990, 2000 and 2010 censuses are on the same page, and a census data platform and a dynamic query system give further breakdowns. Format and access: free XLSX and ODS downloads. Licence: DGBAS site material is released under the Open Government Data License, version 1.0, free of charge and for any use. Caveats: the file server sends an incomplete certificate chain, so strict clients must add the TWCA intermediate from its AIA address, and the report tables stop at county level. Simulation uses: housing age and floor area for seismic exposure and building energy models, and commuting for regional transport demand. Related records: IPUMS International and the GHSL built-up and population grids.
